description: The critic judges the latest generated takes (`stage` keyframes or clips) against each shot’s direction and puts the best on the shot. `stage` cut is the audience review of the render, for any film, generated or not: the viewer it is made for watches it and answers a fixed checklist, naming the shot and the change for each miss (a little model time, billed like an agent’s).
name: critique_video
title: Critique takes or the cut
